scope: Kitty preview session shutdown/reload lifetime; no global exception handler or Pi guard bypass

requirements.contract: No timer scheduled by preview shutdown; tracked flash/hide/stream timers cancelled before ctx invalidation. Retired callbacks never touch old ctx or clear successor widgets.
Owned image-data frees stay scoped and synchronous, including hidden never-mounted galleries; no deferred free reaches a replacement generation.
Late runtime handoff, file preparation, cycle/animation error, overlay and capture/description callbacks are lifetime-gated; stream process and description cancellation is requested on teardown.
Actual Pi ctx invalidation and real process reload survive beyond old timer deadlines. TUI reload preserves process identity and releases scoped graphics/terminal state on exit.

evidence.negative: Fake-clock regression reproduced stale ctx.ui at old kitty-image-preview.js:647 (inline) and :634 (side fallback).
evidence.rpc: Isolated Pi 0.84.4: three reloads with owned data, inline/side placement and hide cleanup; no model or production state.
evidence.pty: Isolated Pi 0.84.4: five real /reload commands for each aboveEditor/belowEditor/rightOverlay; same PID, scoped d=I emitted, clean exit and terminal restoration. Root implementation tested with the audio agent's test-only PTY harness.

deployment: No live update/reload/restart performed. An already-loaded old shutdown handler remains unsafe for the first reload; update package files, then start a fresh process and resume the saved session.
